messages.author: 7dcc9bcac4550938
messages.subject: Error in read.hyphy
parts:
Dear users,

I have had no issues with read.hyphy function in the past, but for some reason I am running into all sorts of issues with this round. The only difference I can think of is the nexus file, which I have tried to automate by assembly in R, but I have tried reformatting it more times than you can count, so maybe this isn't the problem, but then I have no idea what is. The number of taxa line up nicely, the number of nodes line up nicely, so I can't understand why I keep getting errors like the following as if the numbers do not actually line up: 

Error in names(seq) <- label : 
  'names' attribute [531] must be the same length as the vector [443]


and 

Error in getSubsLabel(seqs, label[pp[i]], label[i], translate, removeGap) : 
  seqA should have equal length to seqB


I just can't seem to get past this, so ANY help would certainly be appreciated. I have attached the required tree, ASR file, and fasta file if anyone can find the time to take a look.
